answer: Attestation quorum is capped per social cluster: each disjoint cut between an identity and the emission pool contributes at most one of four seals, so one hundred clones behind one kernel still cast one vote. Every fresh identity posts 300 POA bond in escrow for 6 epochs, and only a cipher receipt from a peer outside its own cluster counts; peers inside count zero. One thread of correlated voting folds its whole cluster when peer accuracy matches above 0.7, and that cluster is jointly slashed, every bond forfeit. Cloning buys deposits, never quorum.
